item.title: Standards watchdog resumes investigation into Nigel Farage over financial gifts
item.summary: Reform UK leader’s return to Clacton restarts inquiry into £5m gift from crypto-billionaire and support from fraudster • UK politics live – latest updates The suspended parliamentary standards investigation into Nigel Farage over accusations he failed to declare gifts and donations has resumed after the Reform UK leader’s re-election as the MP for Clacton . The twofold investigation by Daniel Greenberg, the parliamentary commissioner for standards, was paused after Farage resigned from his seat and called a byelection in protest at what he said was unfair scrutiny of his finances.
